products.label: Fornax Cluster Catalog, CDS VII/180
products.process: Keep the catalogue's certain members that Cosmicflows-4 does not hold; place each at the cluster's Cosmicflows-4 group distance, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky; colour by type and tone by absolute B magnitude as the Nearby Universe field does.
limitations: A member's depth within the cluster is assumed (as deep as wide), not measured.
